root_causes.verification_path_detail: CLI read write_result.write_details; Princess writeResult stores write_result.stats.write_details, so inserted UUID collection was empty and verification skipped as no_inserts_to_verify.
root_causes.source_absence_detail: validatePostWriteReconciliation required all_active_recognised_in_eligible_source === true, which is null/false when legitimate source-absent actives are retained. 1968 = 1958 + 10 is fully accounted.
root_causes.snake_camel_detail: buildWeeklyMaintenanceReport persists manifest_validation / post_write_verification / post_write_reconciliation; evaluatePrincessBaselineAcceptance read camelCase keys, so valid evidence became undefined and produced rollback_manifest_failed, post_write_verification_failed, post_write_reconciliation_failed.
root_causes.lifecycle_detail: executeWeeklyMaintenance finalised the ledger as completed before the outer CLI post-write lifecycle ran, so GitHub failed while cruise_discovery_runs stayed completed.
root_causes.self_hosted_detail: classifyExecutionEnvironment depended on RUNNER_LABELS, which GitHub does not populate automatically. Runner name princess-local-mac was present; report said self_hosted_detected=false and source_environment=local_mac. This did not cause the false failure.

fixes.inserted_row_verification: collectInsertedRecordIds reads stats.write_details first, then write_details, then rollback inserted_record_ids. committed inserts > 0 with 0 verification IDs is post_write_verification_targets_missing.
fixes.post_write_reconciliation: PASS requires arithmetic ok, outstanding inserts 0, proposed updates 0, identity reviews 0, unexplained active rows 0. Source-absent and other recognised policy buckets explain active differences. Source-absence policy and 21-day cutoff unchanged.
fixes.baseline_acceptance_contract: Canonical snake_case only. camelCase is not a second truth model.
fixes.final_outcome: postWriteLifecycle runs after material write and before finalizeMaintenanceRun. Ledger failed/completed and GitHub exit derive from the same verification outcome.
fixes.rollback_evidence: Princess persists pre-apply rollback evidence before mutation. Inserts before_state=ABSENT. Updates keep previous-row snapshots. Persist failure blocks writes. Today's historical manifest 773017ba was not modified.
fixes.self_hosted_detection: Uses RUNNER_NAME, RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT, ImageOS, and labels. Cloud-hosted APPLY remains forbidden. Workflow runs-on self-hosted princess-local-mac unchanged.
fixes.schedule_observability: WARN-only delay minutes vs cron 0 21 * * 0. Cron not changed.

scheduling.recommendation: Keep Princess on the GitHub Actions self-hosted Mac path for now. The 120-minute GitHub schedule delay is a platform jitter issue, not an inventory defect. A later migration onto the shared Netlify scheduled-maintenance control plane would align Princess with HAL/Celebrity and avoid Actions cron drift, but must not be done in P3M because Princess APPLY is intentionally self-hosted and Netlify-hosted APPLY remains forbidden.
